## Current Research

**UIC's Government Finance Research Center - Cook County Property Tax Reform Project**

I am currently working with CMAP and the Cook County people looking at property taxes using data from the Cook County Assessor's Office. I've been insisting on making all data, findings, code, and bonus content publicly available on GitHub. A website with key findings and tables [can be found here!](https://github.com/uic-gfrc/CookCounty-PropertyTaxes). This research has resulted in three reports released by Cook County and influenced State legislation.

**Fiscal Futures Project**

My little legacy is this GitHub Site and Repository! I joined Fiscal Futures Project in 2021 and transformed the inherited Stata code into R code, while finding errors in past methodology and updating the methodology for the project. Was I asked to do this? No, but I have no chill. What began as personal documentation to track coding logic and my deep dives into the data slowly warped into an RPubs site and then became a [full-blown GitHub website](https://github.com/igpa-uillinois/Fiscal-Futures).
